title: Aerospace – Lead and Runout Threads, Part 2: Internal Threads
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 3353 specifies the lead and runout thread and undercut requirements for internal threads (blind tapped holes) for aerospace construction. It is applicable whenever it is referenced in a definition document.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Specificaation for aerospace bolts and nuts (MJ threads) Part 1 Basic profile

clause_3_terminology: Aerospace – Lead and Runout Threads, Part 2: Internal Threads

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
